text_block_list.text:
After school.
When I went to the library to look for training materials,
I found Narita Top Road wearing a serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Hmm, yeah...
I've read most of the books around here,
so a dictionary might be best after all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Good work today, Trainer.
Well, calling it studying is a bit, um...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...A-Actually, you see...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...And that's how it is.

To summarize Narita Top Road's story simply,
it seems she wants to fix how her vocabulary
suddenly fails her out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've been aware of it all along!
I've always been thinking about wanting to do something about it, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
For now, I think I'll try memorizing
a bunch of words from the dictionary!
"...It's not a bad thing, but I don't think it'll solve the root of the problem."

For it wasn't that Narita Top Road lacked the words.
It was just that—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Ah, but before that. Trainer, would you please practice 'having a conversation' with me!?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
By being mindful of it right from the start as we talk,
it should help pinpoint where the problem is!

Accepting Narita Top Road's request,
we decided to change locations to help
find something to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's so peaceful...
It's nice and calming, or maybe...
Ah, the vegetables are ready!
choice_data_list: Is it about time for the harvest?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps so!
Whoa~ It looks so fresh and delicious.
It must have been raised with lots of love.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
They have such a wide variety of goods here,
so even if I only mean to take a quick look,
I end up buying a bunch of things.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. We both need to be careful.
We shouldn't spend recklessly
and blow through our allowance.

I tried striking up various conversations in different places,
but they all resulted in ordinary small talk.
As I thought, everyday conversation poses no problem.

To begin with, the reason Narita Top Road usually gets tongue-tied
is mostly because—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, on that desk...
there's a massive amount of documents.
Are they all related to training?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Your training menus always
get fine-tuned specifically for me, after all, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since the moment we met,
Trainer has studied so hard
just for my sake..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: That's not true! Trainer, you're, um, totally... amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
She's a hard worker, and her effort is...
Um, truly incredible!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...So I really shouldn't get overly excited.
Now that I think about it, that really is when words fail me the most..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: If it doesn't get through, there's no point, right? I wonder if I really need to learn how to stay calm all the time...

Narita Top Road is honest
and almost clumsily straightforward.
That's why I'm sure—
Those feelings, too, must carry far more emotion than mere words could ever convey.
choice_data_list: Your feelings are coming through loud and clear.
How about trying to express it with gestures?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
R-Really?
Even if I don't say enough, does my meaning still get through?

Anyone who knows the Umamusume named
Narita Top Road would surely feel her
earnest feelings, even if they weren't me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you so much!
Then at the very least, I want to keep
telling you over and over again!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Whatever I lack in skill, I'll make up for with quantity! You bet!"

Her expression alone said it all—
and I simply nodded back at Narita Top Road
as she smiled joyfully.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Gestures... I see!
It's true, Opera O-chan and the others
often move their bodies along with their words!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: All riiiight, I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Trainer!
You put in, um, so much effort!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
choice_data_list: I-I get what you mean, really...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!! Th-That's so embarrassing...!
Please forget what you just saw! Forget it right now!

I comforted Narita Top Road, whose face had gone bright red,
while desperately holding back my laughter...
